import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { messages } from "../../../backend/schema/messages";

// A board over "bodyFormat" fits this table, but a board needs a text column to keep each card's order in. Add one, then declare kanban: { columnField: "bodyFormat", orderField: "<that column>" }.
export const messagesCms = customizeTable<typeof messages>("messages", {
    icon: "Mail",
    display: {
        title: "title"
    },
    listFields: ["id", "title", "bodyFormat", "sentOn", "messageRead", "toUserVisible"],
    fields: {
        title: {
            multiline: true
        },
        body: {
            multiline: true,
            markdown: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "title",
        "bodyFormat",
        "sentOn",
        "messageRead",
        "toUserVisible",
        "fromUserVisible",
        "muted",
        "fromUser",
        "toUser",
        "body"
    ]
});
